plain_statement.zh: 求相距 2h 的两个大弧系数的混合二阶矩，对 h³≤N 一致。
plain_statement.en: Determine the shifted second moment uniformly for h³≤N.

brief.zh: #4275 只控制单点下界。若 p∤h，则 p 不能同时整除 m 和 m+2h；若 p|h，则两条件重合，这给出不同的局部二阶项。须证明有限分母截断误差对移动的 h 一致。h=0 包含真正的二阶矩。
brief.en: Use intersection versus exclusion of the two divisibility events at odd p. Control the cutoff uniformly as h varies; h=0 recovers the unshifted second moment. The average is over the intersection of the two reflected bands.
